How ordering works

Four simple steps. No app, no account — everything is confirmed on WhatsApp.

1

Build your list

Pick your sabzi above, set quantities — 250 g to 5 kg, pieces or bunches, just like at the thela.

2

Send it on WhatsApp

One tap turns your list into a ready WhatsApp message to Fresh Subzi on +91 70976 67786.

3

Fresh Subzi picks it fresh

Fresh Subzi sources against confirmed orders at the mandi — so nothing sits around going stale.

4

Delivered to your door

Your sabzi arrives in the slot Fresh Subzi confirms with you, and payment is settled with them directly.

Sourced every morning

From the mandi floor to your kitchen — the same day.

Supermarket sabzi can sit in cold storage for days. Ours doesn't. Fresh Subzi buys against confirmed orders each morning, so what reaches your kitchen was on the mandi floor hours earlier — crisp, bright and full of flavour.

  • Hand-checked, piece by pieceSoft, spotted or overripe pieces never make it into your bag.
  • Bought only against ordersNo godown stock, no week-old vegetables — zero waste, full freshness.
  • Fair mandi rates, confirmed firstYour bill is shared on WhatsApp before delivery. Happy with it? Only then we deliver.
  • Not happy with a piece? Say soMessage Fresh Subzi on WhatsApp the same day so they can sort it out with you directly.

    Good questions

    How do I pay?

    You never pay anything on this website — there is no online checkout here. Payment is arranged directly with Fresh Subzi on WhatsApp when your order and final bill are confirmed.

    Why aren't prices shown on the site?

    Because sabzi rates genuinely change every morning with the mandi. Instead of showing you a stale price, Fresh Subzi confirms today's exact rate for every item on WhatsApp before delivery — you approve the bill first, then we deliver.

    When should I order?

    Send your list whenever you are ready — Fresh Subzi will confirm the next available delivery slot on WhatsApp. Ordering the evening before gives the best chance of produce picked fresh the next morning.

    Can I order something that isn't listed?

    Yes. Add it in the "Anything else?" box in the order form — seasonal vegetables, fruits or a specific variety. If it's available in the mandi that morning, it will be in your bag.

    What if a vegetable isn't good?

    Message Fresh Subzi on WhatsApp the same day, with a photo if you can, and they will sort it out with you directly.

    Where can I see the full catalogue?

    The complete, always-updated catalogue lives on WhatsApp: open the Fresh Subzi WhatsApp catalogue, or follow daily updates on Instagram at @fresh_subzi.
